title: How far the clock was pushed, and what it left in slack
alt: Kernel slack against the clock for the 44 U50 builds this figure reads from the ledger, and the slack of the images built at 130 and 135 MHz in build order. One tile closes 175 MHz; four tiles close 135.
commit_means: the commit the extracts below were read at; a file read from the tree is identified by its SHA-256 instead
